text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the west side of Rowley Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Designated an on-street accessible parking space to operate on the west side of Rowley Avenue, between a point 72 metres north of Roehampton Avenue and a point 5.5 metres further north.
